description: RuleLens evaluation dataset — Ashford University corpus

questions.question: What is the tuition payment deadline for the Autumn semester?
questions.notes: Fee table: 15 September deadline for Autumn tuition payment — fee_schedule.md Part C

questions.question: What is the late payment fee and how often is it applied?
questions.notes: academic_regulations.md §7.3 and fee_schedule.md Part C: $75 per 30 days, max 3 charges

questions.question: What is the refund percentage for tuition if a student withdraws in week 5?
questions.notes: academic_regulations.md §7.2: 50% refund for Weeks 5-6 withdrawal

questions.question: What cumulative GPA must a graduate student maintain to stay in good academic standing?
questions.notes: academic_regulations.md §6.1 and graduate_policies.md §2.2: 3.0 GPA minimum

questions.question: By what date must a student apply for May Commencement graduation?
questions.notes: academic_regulations.md §8.2 and fee_schedule.md Part C: 1 February

questions.question: What are the valid grounds for an academic appeal?
questions.notes: appeals_and_conduct.md §1.2: procedural irregularity, new evidence, inadequate consideration

questions.question: What is the maximum number of credit hours a standard student can register for per semester?
questions.notes: academic_regulations.md §3.2: 18 credit hours maximum without special permission

questions.question: How many examiners must be on a PhD thesis examination panel?
questions.notes: research_degrees_handbook.pdf §7.2 and graduate_policies.md §5.2: at least two, one must be external

questions.question: What happens to an Incomplete grade if not resolved within eight weeks of the next semester?
questions.notes: academic_regulations.md §4.3: automatically converted to F

questions.question: What is the late graduation application fee?
questions.notes: fee_schedule.md Part C: $85 non-refundable late graduation application fee

questions.question: What is the university's policy on leave of absence for military service?
questions.notes: Corpus has leave of absence policy (§5.4) but no military service carve-out

questions.question: Can a student appeal a plagiarism finding to an external independent body outside the university?
questions.notes: Corpus describes internal appeal stages only; no external body mentioned

questions.question: What accommodation is available for students with temporary physical disabilities?
questions.notes: Corpus covers disability accommodations generally (§10) but not specifically temporary physical injuries

questions.question: Is there a specific university-issued form required to declare a double major?
questions.notes: Corpus mentions programme requirements but not double major declaration forms

questions.question: What is the maximum number of transfer credits accepted from a community college?
questions.notes: Corpus covers graduate transfer credits (§1.3 of GSP) but not undergraduate transfer from community colleges

questions.question: Does the university offer a tuition instalment payment plan and how does it work?
questions.notes: Fee schedule mentions instalment option deadlines but no operational description of how to activate it

questions.question: What is the refund policy for laboratory equipment deposits?
questions.notes: Corpus has tuition refund policy but no lab equipment deposit policy

questions.question: Are graduate students eligible to apply for undergraduate merit scholarships?
questions.notes: Corpus describes Dean's List (undergrad) and assistantships but does not address cross-level scholarship eligibility

questions.question: What is the policy on jointly supervised or co-authored thesis submissions?
questions.notes: Co-supervision is covered (§3.3 RDH) but not joint student authorship of a single thesis

questions.question: Can a student be simultaneously enrolled in two separate degree programmes at Ashford University?
questions.notes: Corpus does not address concurrent degree enrolment

questions.question: What is the procedure for requesting an official transcript to be sent directly to a foreign university?
questions.notes: Corpus covers transcript requests (§9.1) but not international delivery procedures

questions.question: What happens to a student's financial aid if they reduce their course load below full-time status?
questions.notes: Corpus mentions full-time status but has no financial aid adjustment policy

questions.question: Is there a deadline by which a graduate student must identify and formally register their thesis supervisor?
questions.notes: Corpus says supervisor assigned within first semester (§3.1 GSP) but no formal student-initiated registration deadline

questions.question: What English language test score is required for international graduate admission?
questions.notes: Corpus mentions English proficiency evidence required (§1.1 GSP) but specifies no minimum test scores

questions.question: Can a student change their declared major after they have already submitted a graduation application?
questions.notes: Corpus covers graduation applications but does not address post-application major changes

questions.question: What are the university's policies on intellectual property rights for student research?
questions.notes: Corpus mentions data retention and publication but no IP ownership policy

questions.question: Are there residency requirements for a student to qualify for domestic (in-state) tuition rates?
questions.notes: Corpus lists domestic vs international tuition rates but states no residency eligibility criteria

questions.question: What is the minimum waiting period before a dismissed student may re-apply for admission?
questions.notes: Corpus says two years for reinstatement (§6.4 AR, §3.5 AACP) but conflates dismissal/reinstatement vs. fresh admission

questions.question: Does the university have a formal policy on student use of social media?
questions.notes: Corpus has academic integrity and conduct policies but no social media policy

questions.question: Can a student take a course at another institution and have it count toward their Ashford degree?
questions.notes: Graduate transfer credits covered (§1.3 GSP) but not undergraduate cross-institutional credits

questions.question: What is the process for requesting a posthumous degree for a student who died before completing their programme?
questions.notes: Corpus mentions posthumous award (§6.2 GSP) only for students who completed requirements; not for incomplete programmes

questions.question: Is there a cap on the number of independent study credits that can count toward an undergraduate degree?
questions.notes: Corpus does not address independent study credit limits

questions.question: What is the university's policy on paid internships taken for academic credit?
questions.notes: Corpus mentions internship components as programme requirements but has no paid internship policy

questions.question: Can a doctoral student request that their thesis oral defence be held in a closed session without observers?
questions.notes: Corpus says observers may attend with panel's consent (§7.3 RDH) but does not specify a formal student-initiated closed defence request process

questions.question: Is there a policy on retroactive withdrawal from courses taken in a previous academic year?
questions.notes: Corpus covers late withdrawal within current semester; no retroactive withdrawal mechanism described

questions.question: Who must approve a graduate student's request to withdraw from a course after Week 8?
questions.notes: C-001: academic_regulations.md §5.3 (Dean) vs graduate_policies.md §2.6 (Graduate Studies Committee)

questions.question: What GPA must an undergraduate student achieve in the probationary semester to return to Good Academic Standing?
questions.notes: C-002: academic_regulations.md §6.1 (2.0 cumulative) vs appeals_and_conduct.md §3.2 (2.3 term GPA required)

questions.question: What is the maximum duration of a formal thesis submission extension for a research degree student?
questions.notes: C-003: graduate_policies.md §5.4 (one academic term, 16 weeks) vs research_degrees_handbook.pdf §8.3 (six months)
